storyboard.character: An elegant woman around 40, light skin, sleek shoulder-length dark blonde hair, wearing a soft champagne silk robe.
storyboard.product: the LACALUT AKTIV tube standing upright on the sink edge, real German label, white cap, tall slim proportions

scenes.visual: Chest-up wide shot of the elegant woman in her bright marble bathroom, calmly fastening a delicate necklace clasp at her collarbone. The LACALUT AKTIV tube stands untouched on the marble ledge in the lower third of the frame, label facing camera.
scenes.motion: Slow natural handheld drift in soft daylight. She fastens the clasp, lowers her hands, then meets the camera with a calm, confident closed-mouth smile at 5s. Camera holds; the tube stays static in the lower third, never zoomed. Gentle ambient room tone.
scenes.vo: My gums used to feel vulnerable. Now they feel resilient and at their best — a simple swap.
